events.title: 리버풀 take another step towards title glory by beating 선덜랜드 1–0 at Anfield, although 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure with a 3–0 home win over 코번트리 시티. 왓퍼드's title hopes are now virtually dead after they lose 2–1 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드.

토트넘 홋스퍼 give their hopes of qualifying for the UEFA Cup a huge boost by beating 아스널 5–0 in the North London derby at White Hart Lane . 왓퍼드 go second with a 5–2 home win over local rivals 루턴 타운, who remain second from bottom of the First Division. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw at 선덜랜드. In the Third Division, 뉴포트 카운티 go top of the table with a 1–0 win over South Wales rivals 카디프 시티 in a promotion crunch game at Somerton Park , boosting the Monmouthshire side's chances of reaching the Second Division for only the second time in the club's history.

노팅엄 포리스트 go fifth in the First Division with a 2–1 win over 코번트리 시티 at Highfield Road . Brighton miss the chance to move out of the bottom three when they are held to a goalless draw at 사우샘프턴. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's resurgence continues with a 5–1 away win over 스완지 시티, which puts them firmly back in the hunt for a UEFA Cup place and deepens the home side's relegation worries.

리버풀 now need just five points from their last seven games to clinch the First Division title after beating 스완지 시티, managed by former 리버풀 striker John Toshack , 3–0 at Anfield, a result which sends the Swans back into the bottom three. 루턴 타운 climb out of the relegation zone at Swansea's expense by beating 애스턴 빌라 2–1 at Kenilworth Road. 맨체스터 유나이티드 drop two points when 사우샘프턴 hold them to a 1–1 draw at Old Trafford, but 왓퍼드 help delay 리버풀's wait for the title by beating 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–1 away from home. A relegation crunch game at St Andrew's sees 버밍엄 시티 lose 4–0 at home to 노리치 시티.

리버풀 drop two points when 코번트리 시티 hold them to a goalless draw at Highfield Road. Time is running out for 버밍엄 시티 in their battle to avoid relegation when they go down 3–1 to 루턴 타운 in a relegation crunch clash at Kenilworth Road.

맨체스터 유나이티드 reach their ninth FA Cup final with a 2–1 win over 아스널 at Villa Park . Brighton reach a cup final for the first time by winning the other semi-final 2–1 against 셰필드 웬즈데이 at Highbury . 리버풀's wait for the First Division title is further delayed by a 3–2 defeat at 사우샘프턴. 노리치 시티 move closer to safety with a 2–0 home win over 선덜랜드, while 버밍엄 시티's survival bid is boosted by a 1–0 away win over 코번트리 시티.

맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–0 defeat at 에버턴 means that 리버풀 now need just one point from their final five league games to be sure of the title, while the win is also a boost to Howard Kendall 's team in their challenge for a UEFA Cup place. FA Cup finalists Brighton move closer to relegation after being held to a 1–1 draw at 선덜랜드. QPR now need just two points from their final six Second Division games to secure promotion after a 1–0 away win over 셰필드 웬즈데이.
노리치 시티 move closer to survival with a 3–1 home win over 아스널. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 keep their faint promotion hopes alive in the Second Division by beating struggling 로더럼 유나이티드 4–0 on Tyneside .

리버풀 are made to wait for the league title after losing 2–0 at home to 노리치 시티, with 맨체스터 유나이티드's 2–0 home win over 왓퍼드 ensuring that 밥 페이즐리's team have to wait at least another game to seal the title. A Second Division promotion crunch game at Craven Cottage sees 레스터 시티 beat 풀럼 1–0 and cut the gap between third and fourth place to just two points. Meanwhile, 풀럼's West London rivals QPR confirm their promotion with a 1–0 home win over 리즈 유나이티드. 헐 시티 are promoted from the Fourth Division with a 1–0 win over 크루 알렉산드라 at Boothferry Park .
England beat Hungary 2–0 at Wembley in a European Championship qualifier.

맨체스터 유나이티드's 1–1 draw at 노리치 시티 seals the First Division title for 리버풀, despite their 2–0 defeat to 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane. 노팅엄 포리스트 move closer to securing a UEFA Cup place with a 2–1 away win over 맨체스터 시티, which leaves the hosts on the brink of the relegation zone. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat 크리스털 팰리스 1–0 in their Second Division clash at the Molineux, leaving them needing just two points from their final three games to secure an immediate return to the First Division. 윔블던 also seal an immediate return to the Third Division after beating 크루 알렉산드라 2–0 at Gresty Road .
